item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky made a surprise visit to Madrid on Wednesday to drum up fresh military support against Russia during a summit of Latin American leaders in Spain. Madrid is hosting a two-day summit of the Ibero-American Community, a 22-nation group of Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries where support for Ukraine since Russia's 2022 invasion has divided opinion. item.title: ‘If death is my destiny’: Sheikh Hasina firm on returning to Bangladesh in December
item.description: Sheikh Hasina has confirmed her intention to return to Bangladesh, despite facing a death sentence. The former Prime Minister is aware of the risks associated with her return, including potential arrest or worse. Hasina's Awami League party has been banned, resulting in widespread political repression and violence against its members. She expressed concerns over the rising influence of extremist groups in the current political climate. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Warming UK seas could ‘fundamentally reshape marine ecosystems’ – report
item.description: Four-year study warns destabilised marine food webs could jeopardise food security by 2050 Warming seas around the UK and the wider north-east Atlantic could destabilise marine food webs, weaken ocean health and jeopardise food security by 2050, according to a four-year study. Scientists who projected the impact of climate breakdown on four key groups of marine life crucial to maintaining ocean ecosystems in the region said their results challenged assumptions that in middle latitudes, such as the UK, marine biodiversity was likely to increase across the board. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Centuries-old cemetery helps scientists link climate shocks to Industrial Revolution disease
item.description: During England's Industrial Revolution, when the country's farming-based economy transformed into an industrial one between roughly 1760 and 1840, pollution, harsh working conditions, inadequate housing and limited access to sunlight drove disease. Rickets, in which the growing skeleton fails to properly mineralize, was commonplace among children. Traditionally, urbanization, latitude and socioeconomic status were considered the main drivers. A factor that has largely been overlooked is climate. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.description: La victoria de los demócratas en las midterms, que les dejó el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso estadounidense, puede abrir un nuevo frente de oposición a Donald Trump sobre política exterior. Desde la guerra contra Irán hasta el apoyo a Ucrania e Israel, pasando por la política hacia América Latina, los legisladores podrán utilizar su poder para limitar las decisiones de Donald Trump. item.title: El papa León XIV visitará Zaña, el pueblo marcado por la tragedia en Perú
item.description: Durante siglos, Zaña, en el norte de Perú, ha estado rodeada de relatos sobre tragedias y una supuesta maldición desde que una devastadora inundación destruyó gran parte de la ciudad colonial en el siglo XVIII. Hoy, este pueblo de unos 4.000 habitantes se prepara para un acontecimiento histórico: la visita del papa al santuario de Santo Toribio de Mogrovejo. Los vecinos han impulsado colectas y trabajos de restauración para recibir al pontífice. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: How ranchers on Brazil's 'Dirty List' bypass forced labor safeguards by selling cattle through intermediaries
item.description: Brazil's "Dirty List," a public registry that names employers found to have violated anti-slavery laws, is a key component of the country's efforts to combat forced labor. Major meatpackers in Brazil signed sustainable sourcing commitments promising to not purchase cattle directly from ranchers on the Dirty List. But new research shows that ranchers have found ways around these restrictions, rerouting cattle through intermediaries and allowing cattle linked to forced labor to remain in domestic and international beef and leather supply chains. Fuente: Phys.org.
